DEN_undermine_overlord_continuous_focus.description: We must do what we can to resist and undermine our Overlords to ensure Danish sovereignty.
DEN_undermine_overlord_continuous_focus.title: Undermine Overlord Influence

ETH_strengthen_the_black_lions.description: Although we have lost land to the enemy, the fight must go on. The Black Lions are offering a great deal of resistance to the Italian’s and we should therefore support them anyway we can.
ETH_strengthen_the_black_lions.title: Strengthen the Black Lions

ETH_supporting_the_arbegnoch.description: Across [ROOT.GetName] there are patriots willing to take up arms against the [ITA.GetAdjective] invaders. We must do everything we can to support these brave men and women in crippling the [ITA.GetAdjective] war machine.
ETH_supporting_the_arbegnoch.title: Supporting the Arbegnoch

SWI_build_up_military_readiness.description: The task of preparing the Swiss population is never-ending. We cannot rest until the threat of invasion is gone, and it might never be. We must orient our nation towards defensive preparations without delay.
SWI_build_up_military_readiness.title: Build up Military Readiness

SWI_support_active_militias_continuous_f.description: Our citizens are armed and deployed into their local militias, it is everyone else's duty to support them however they can so we can keep the enemies of the confederation at bay
SWI_support_active_militias_continuous_f.title: Support Active Militias

baltic_soviet_collapse_a_baltic_army_not.description: The compact turns separate militias into a coordinated Baltic force with shared commands and reserve tables.
baltic_soviet_collapse_a_baltic_army_not.title: A Baltic Army, Not Three Militias

baltic_soviet_collapse_a_port_without_a_.description: The harbor remains open to aid but closed to foreign ownership.
baltic_soviet_collapse_a_port_without_a_.title: A Port Without a Master

baltic_soviet_collapse_baltic_defense_co.description: The Baltic governments prepare a league defense charter without joining a wider bloc before the crisis demands it.
baltic_soviet_collapse_baltic_defense_co.title: Baltic League Defense

baltic_soviet_collapse_baltic_league_fir.description: The republic treats Baltic coordination as the first shield, binding its fate to the other restored states.
baltic_soviet_collapse_baltic_league_fir.title: Baltic League First

baltic_soviet_collapse_baltic_recognitio.description: The republic brings legal papers, witness statements, port controls, and casualty reports together for foreign missions to verify.
baltic_soviet_collapse_baltic_recognitio.title: Baltic Recognition Dossier

baltic_soviet_collapse_baltic_shield_doc.description: The compact builds a defensive doctrine around ports, forests, borders, and shared reserves.
baltic_soviet_collapse_baltic_shield_doc.title: Baltic Shield Doctrine

baltic_soviet_collapse_british_naval_obs.description: Naval observers inspect the ports, the customs books, and the coast guard without receiving command over them.
baltic_soviet_collapse_british_naval_obs.title: British Naval Observers

baltic_soviet_collapse_call_the_prewar_d.description: Surviving deputies and municipal leaders are summoned to give the restored state a civilian voice.
baltic_soviet_collapse_call_the_prewar_d.title: Call the Prewar Deputies

baltic_soviet_collapse_coastal_defense_b.description: Coast guards and artillery crews prepare the ports to survive blockade, landing attempts, and panic.
baltic_soviet_collapse_coastal_defense_b.title: Coastal Defense Batteries

baltic_soviet_collapse_emergency_border_.description: Border police, railway guards, and local volunteers form the first screen against a Soviet return.
baltic_soviet_collapse_emergency_border_.title: Emergency Border Guard

baltic_soviet_collapse_estonian_forest_c.description: Coastal batteries and forest posts are planned as one defense, forcing any Soviet return to fight through ports, roads, and wooded depth.
baltic_soviet_collapse_estonian_forest_c.title: Estonian Forest-Coast Guard

baltic_soviet_collapse_foreign_advisers_.description: Advisers may train, inspect, and recommend, but they work under Baltic statutes and local officers.
baltic_soviet_collapse_foreign_advisers_.title: Foreign Advisers Under Baltic Law

baltic_soviet_collapse_foreign_protectio.description: Foreign missions are invited to protect the republic's survival, but every promise carries a price.
baltic_soviet_collapse_foreign_protectio.title: Foreign Protection Council

baltic_soviet_collapse_forest_and_marsh_.description: Forests, marshes, and local guides become depth behind the border guard.
baltic_soviet_collapse_forest_and_marsh_.title: Forest and Marsh Lines

baltic_soviet_collapse_german_border_pre.description: Pressure from the southwest is acknowledged, watched, and turned into a warning that no protector owns the border.
baltic_soviet_collapse_german_border_pre.title: German Border Pressure

baltic_soviet_collapse_guard_the_archive.description: The republic guards archive rooms, parish papers, court documents, and occupation files to defend its legal claim from seizure or destruction.
baltic_soviet_collapse_guard_the_archive.title: Guard the Archives

baltic_soviet_collapse_latvian_port_guar.description: Port guards, naval engineers, and reserve officers keep Riga's approaches under Latvian command while observers and patrons crowd the harbor.
baltic_soviet_collapse_latvian_port_guar.title: Latvian Port Guard Boards

baltic_soviet_collapse_legal_continuity_.description: The cabinet grounds every order in legal continuity and makes recognition the center of survival.
baltic_soviet_collapse_legal_continuity_.title: Legal Continuity Government

baltic_soviet_collapse_lithuanian_interi.description: Factories, forest routes, and border posts are organized into an interior line that can hold if the first frontier is broken.
baltic_soviet_collapse_lithuanian_interi.title: Lithuanian Interior Line

baltic_soviet_collapse_military_border_g.description: Commanders take wider emergency powers so the border can hold while civilian institutions stay under pressure.
baltic_soviet_collapse_military_border_g.title: Military Border Government

baltic_soviet_collapse_no_retreat_from_t.description: The capital prepares last roads, reserve posts, and public orders for a defense that cannot look temporary.
baltic_soviet_collapse_no_retreat_from_t.title: No Retreat from the Capital

baltic_soviet_collapse_pan_baltic_war_ro.description: Shared maps, signals, and reserve forces let the Baltic compact plan one defensive front.
baltic_soviet_collapse_pan_baltic_war_ro.title: Pan-Baltic War Room

baltic_soviet_collapse_ports_before_patr.description: Port access remains under local law, even when foreign aid and naval observers crowd the harbor offices.
baltic_soviet_collapse_ports_before_patr.title: Ports Before Patronage

baltic_soviet_collapse_radio_appeals_to_.description: Radio rooms and exile contacts send the Baltic case northward before Moscow can close the airwaves.
baltic_soviet_collapse_radio_appeals_to_.title: Radio Appeals to the North

baltic_soviet_collapse_rail_to_the_ports.description: Rail dispatchers and harbor clerks keep the routes to the ports open for supplies, refugees, and observers.
baltic_soviet_collapse_rail_to_the_ports.title: Rail to the Ports

baltic_soviet_collapse_restore_the_state.description: The emergency government presents the state seal, prewar statutes, and municipal documents to prove the republic?s legal continuity.
baltic_soviet_collapse_restore_the_state.title: Restore the State Seal

baltic_soviet_collapse_riga_corridor_swi.description: Latvia brings Riga?s rail offices, port facilities, and supply dispatchers under a corridor authority that keeps the emergency state connected.
baltic_soviet_collapse_riga_corridor_swi.title: Riga Corridor Switchyards

baltic_soviet_collapse_scandinavian_list.description: Northern contacts hear the republic's case through careful radio rooms, consular notes, and guarded witnesses.
baltic_soviet_collapse_scandinavian_list.title: Scandinavian Listening Mission

baltic_soviet_collapse_singing_barricade.description: Songs, crowds, radios, and guarded streets turn civic courage into a high-chaos defense of the restored state.
baltic_soviet_collapse_singing_barricade.title: The Singing Barricades Early

baltic_soviet_collapse_sponsor_fleet_rig.description: The government trades limited fleet rights for aid while trying to keep every agreement inside Baltic law.
baltic_soviet_collapse_sponsor_fleet_rig.title: Sponsor Fleet Rights

baltic_soviet_collapse_tallinn_harbor_cu.description: Estonia places Tallinn's harbor clerks, dockyard shifts, and naval observers under a single customs board before aid becomes foreign control.
baltic_soviet_collapse_tallinn_harbor_cu.title: Tallinn Harbor Customs

baltic_soviet_collapse_tallinn_riga_viln.description: The compact rotates its chair and staff desks so no capital can turn solidarity into command.
baltic_soviet_collapse_tallinn_riga_viln.title: Tallinn, Riga, Vilnius Rotation

baltic_soviet_collapse_the_baltic_custom.description: Customs clerks fund the emergency through controlled trade, inspections, and legal port fees.
baltic_soviet_collapse_the_baltic_custom.title: The Baltic Customs Desk

baltic_soviet_collapse_the_baltic_questi.description: The republic defines its place in the crisis: restored state, border government, compact member, neutral port, or protected ally.
baltic_soviet_collapse_the_baltic_questi.title: The Baltic Question Resolved

baltic_soviet_collapse_the_border_front_.description: The border government fortifies crossings, signals, and local posts before the crisis reaches the capital.
baltic_soviet_collapse_the_border_front_.title: The Border Front at Home

baltic_soviet_collapse_the_legal_front_a.description: Diplomats, jurists, and exile committees argue the restoration case beyond the reach of Soviet censors.
baltic_soviet_collapse_the_legal_front_a.title: The Legal Front Abroad

baltic_soviet_collapse_the_legal_state_o.description: The republic chooses whether law, borders, Baltic solidarity, or foreign protection will lead the emergency.
baltic_soviet_collapse_the_legal_state_o.title: The Legal State or the Front State

baltic_soviet_collapse_the_port_economy.description: Customs offices and guarded warehouses turn sea access into fuel, tools, and pay for the emergency state.
baltic_soviet_collapse_the_port_economy.title: The Port Economy

baltic_soviet_collapse_the_second_restor.description: The restored state proves it can survive war, diplomacy, and panic without surrendering its legal claim.
baltic_soviet_collapse_the_second_restor.title: The Second Restoration

baltic_soviet_collapse_university_volunt.description: Students, lecturers, and reservists are listed for signals, medical, officer, and rifle units under tight manpower limits.
baltic_soviet_collapse_university_volunt.title: University Volunteer Lists

baltic_soviet_collapse_vilnius_border_st.description: Lithuania turns its border claims, legal files, and capital defense orders into statutes that can be shown to allies and enforced by guards.
baltic_soviet_collapse_vilnius_border_st.title: Vilnius Border Statutes

baltic_soviet_collapse_volunteer_rifle_s.description: Civilian rifle societies and defense leagues turn patriotic meetings into trained local companies.
baltic_soviet_collapse_volunteer_rifle_s.title: Volunteer Rifle Societies

continuous_air_production.description: We can reorganize our aviation industry to eliminate waste and streamline production.
continuous_air_production.title: Air Production

continuous_boost_freedom.description: By reorganizing our colonial bureaucracy and recruiting native administrators, we will, in time, be able to take charge of our own affairs.
continuous_boost_freedom.title: Increase Autonomy

continuous_naval_production.description: By focusing resources on our shipyards and exempting skilled shipbuilders from military service, we can dramatically reduce production time for ships.
continuous_naval_production.title: Naval Production

continuous_non_factory_construct.description: There is still a lot of slack in our construction industry. By focusing our attention on it, we can achieve a significant improvement in construction speed. Unfortunately, the production of machine tools has proven a major bottleneck in the expansion of our heavy industry, so they won't benefit from efforts in this area.
continuous_non_factory_construct.title: Construction Engineering

continuous_reduce_training_time.description: By creating specialized advanced training units within each division, we can deploy even divisions that would previously have been held back to finish training to the front.
continuous_reduce_training_time.title: Army Training

continuous_repair.description: We will form specialized repair teams from factory and construction workers and centrally control their deployment to improve reconstruction of damaged infrastructure.
continuous_repair.title: Construction Repair

continuous_suppression.description: By infiltrating the major resistance groups in occupied territory and turning their leaders, we can significantly reduce the amount of damage they can do.
continuous_suppression.title: Resistance Suppression

continuous_tech_share.description: We will encourage our research institutes and universities to reach out to their counterparts in allied countries. This will gain us a tech sharing bonus.
continuous_tech_share.title: Technology Sharing
